notes.title: OTK Winter Showcase Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=e8SAnLWqwkY;full][/previewyoutube]

For those who have been waiting -
We have a new trailer to show!
It’s probably the trailer with richest content this far – the horror elements and sanity effects, combat, enemy variety, light/flashlight mechanics, bullet-time, dismemberment, power-ups, environmental hazards, parry and more~
We especially like you to experience some of the environment ambient scenes, as it captures the richness of the mood of some of the new levels we just crafted.
Sorry that we’re not updating as frequently as we should – being a small development team, it’s TONS of work. The biggest priority of our goal is to make sure that we deliver something good in the final product, I'm very confident that we’ll eventually offer something unique and fun.

The early access build of the game will launch in 2025 if everything goes smoothly.  Stay tuned!
